notes: §1985:VII.3.9.3 SR2: "Data-name-1 must be in the Working-Storage Section." FileControlBinder.CaptureValueOf records each data-name-1 and ResolveValueOfDataNames, run once the data division is bound (so a Working-Storage item described after the FILE SECTION resolves), refuses any item whose Section is not WorkingStorage with COBOL6849; the clause itself is gated to 85 (VisitValueOfClause, COBOL0902 from 2002). Probes at 85: the witness's file record item F1-REC, an elementary file-section field, the 01 record itself and a LINKAGE item each refused naming their section; the same fault in an indexed FD refused; Working-Storage elementary, group, qualified and ODO-group operands accepted and run (FS=00).

next.reason: 1985: "Data-name-1 must be in the Working-Storage Section. (VALUE OF clause)"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the VALUE OF clause; no candidate covers it". No 2023 clause carries the VALUE OF clause of the file description entry. The wording candidates concern other clauses (RECORD, FILE STATUS, SAME AS and others), so the feature is dropped.
